name: Southern Flavoring Company, Inc.
old_description: Happy Home Baking Flavors & Extracts are the must-have ingredient for your favorite recipes.
about:
Southern Flavoring Company, Inc. operates from Bedford, Virginia, where it was founded in 1929. The business began in the Claytor family kitchen, where batches of vanilla flavoring were hand-prepared before the company expanded into a commercial operation. The Claytor family remains central to the company's identity, though the current ownership structure is not publicly detailed beyond its family origins.

Today the company produces a line of baking flavors and extracts under the Happy Home Baking brand, including vanilla, lemon, butter & nut, and bakery emulsions. In addition to its own branded products, Southern Flavoring provides co-packing services: white-label and ready-to-label goods, contract packaging, and private-label manufacturing. The firm describes its packaging and shipping capabilities as scalable for culinary brands, though it does not disclose facility size, headcount, or annual volume.

The company serves both retail consumers and business-to-business customers. Home bakers purchase extracts directly through the company's online shop, while culinary brands and food manufacturers engage Southern Flavoring for contract packaging and private-label production. The firm's marketing emphasizes the baking community, featuring recipes that incorporate its flavorings.

Southern Flavoring traces its differentiation to its 1929 heritage and the continuity of family recipes. The company positions its co-packing offering as a way for emerging brands to access quality flavor bases and packaging infrastructure without large upfront investment.
